annotations.title: Get a team's roster and coaches

description: Coaching staff and players for one team. Most teams on this site publish coaches but NOT players, so an empty players list is normal, not an error. Requires the sport slug and team id. Read-only.

sportSlug.description: Sport slug, "<gender>-<sport>", e.g. boys-football, girls-volleyball. From mpaz_list_teams.

teamId.description: Numeric team id from mpaz_list_teams / mpaz_resolve_team. Ids differ per school year.

year.description: School year, e.g. "2026-2027". Defaults to the current one. Past seasons often work; resolve that year's team id with mpaz_list_teams first and read its `coverage` note.

name: mpaz_get_roster
title: Get a team's roster and coaches
